name: Emperor Chiu-Ai (Part Ix. His Death And That Of The Empress Jin-Go).

verses.text: Altogether the august years of this Heavenly Sovereign Tarashi-naka-tsu-hiko were fifty-two. His august mausoleum is at Nagaye, near Wega, in Kafuchi. The Empress died at the august age of one hundred. She was buried in the mausoleum of Tatanami in Saki.
